svg.title: base.yaml and the specs that extend it
svg.desc: base.yaml defines the a1-base harness: gpt-6-luna, five account tools and a policy MCP server, and five middleware components. plain.yaml extends it and drops Schema-Guided Reasoning and the Jev guard. glm-5.3-flash.yaml and mimo-v2.6-flash.yaml extend it and change only the model.
